id8.package_format: npm tgz with package/ root as required by the original deploy tool
id8.completion: A queued install remains pending until the app registry and runtime confirm the installation; do not count staging or exit code alone.
id8.applet_id: Allocate/preserve using current unit metadata; the 20100 value in a historical example is not a universal ID.
id8.sdk_donor: Resolve from the actual current unit and family; the historical oap_12204 donor path is one observation, not a fixed path.

shared.metadata: Per-component mguHmi, corroborated by RHMI UI support and dependencies. An aggregate repository claiming ID7 and ID8 does not make every entry dual-HMI.

compatibility_rules: The App Studio source manifest explicitly has id8Qualified=false.
A helper supporting both HMIs does not make an ID7 app support ID8.
MainApp folder/HMI disagreements must be resolved from actual unit state; do not assume a fixed default.
Do not copy native NBT EVO QNX/ARM packages into the MGU feed.
Historical legacy AQ .mgu lane text conflicts with the later ID8 Store report; use the reviewed original deploy contract and target-specific package format.
